data.risk: Chinese steel and energy demand signals
data.description: China is the dominant buyer of SA chrome, manganese, iron ore, and increasingly thermal coal. Steel production volumes, property sector health, and China's energy mix decisions directly set the floor and ceiling for SA commodity prices and export demand. Slowdown in Chinese steel output immediately compresses SA export prices.

data.description: The Draft Mineral Resources Development Amendment Bill (published May 2025, comment period closed August 2025) proposes local beneficiation obligations, amended mineral rights allocation, and formalisation of artisanal mining. A Forced Beneficiation policy for chrome is under active debate in 2026. The Critical Minerals and Metals Strategy (2025) seeks to restrict raw ore exports in favour of value-added processing. These policies could constrain raw chrome and manganese export volumes.
